description: Largest tracked Hyperliquid wallets with labels (and the label source), open notional, all-time PnL, largest position and its distance to liquidation. Use sort=near_liq for whales close to liquidation.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

labelled.description: Only wallets with a label from a cited source.

sort.description: size = open notional (default), pnl = all-time PnL, near_liq = closest to liquidation, liquidated = most liquidations.

name: get_whales

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

title: Whale leaderboard
